source_caption:
🎬 The Forge (2024)

The Forge follows Isaiah Wright, a 19-year-old young man struggling to find direction in life after finishing high school. With no clear plans for his future and little motivation to take responsibility, Isaiah spends his days playing basketball and video games while his single mother encourages him to make something of himself. His life begins to change when he meets Joshua Moore, a successful businessman who offers him a job and becomes an unexpected mentor. Through guidance, discipline, and faith, Isaiah gradually discovers the importance of hard work, responsibility, and personal growth. As he confronts his past and begins building a better future, he learns valuable lessons about forgiveness, purpose, and becoming the man he was meant to be. The Forge delivers an inspiring story about mentorship, family, faith, and transformation.

🎭 Genre: Drama • Faith • Family

⭐ IMDb: 6.6/10

⏱️ Runtime: 2h 3m • PG

🎥 Director: Alex Kendrick

✍️ Writers: Alex Kendrick & Stephen Kendrick

📺 Where to Watch: Check Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, and Apple TV for current streaming or rental availability in the United States. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: The Forge is a 2024 American independent Christian drama film directed by Alex Kendrick, who co-wrote and co-produced it with Stephen Kendrick. A spin-off to War Room (2015), it is the Kendrick brothers' ninth film and the sixth through their subsidiary, Kendrick Brothers Productions. It stars Cameron Arnett, Priscilla Shirer, Aspen Kennedy, Karen Abercrombie, T. C. Stallings, B. J. Arnett, Ken Bevel, Benjamin Watson, Jonathan Evans, Jerry Shirer, and Tommy Woodard. The Forge was released in the United States by Sony Pictures Releasing on August 23, 2024.
